items.title: Tired of paying for cloud storage every month? pCloud’s Black Friday Lifetime deal is the cure for subscription fatigue
items.raw_content: Software used to be a one-time purchase, but over time, with the addition of cloud storage and services, everything has become a subscription. One company even tried to make your car seat heaters a subscription . Count the subscriptions you’re paying for right now: iCloud, a password manager, a couple of streaming services, a music service, maybe a VPN, and whatever other app decided this year that it needed to be $4.99 per month for something that used to be a one-time purchase. Everything is a service now, and a lot of people are hitting the point where one more monthly charge is one too many on principle alone. Cloud storage is the one that’s hardest to cancel, because your photos and files are in it. That’s exactly why pCloud’s Lifetime plans are worth a look this Black Friday: you pay once, and your storage is yours for life! more…

The changes take effect at midnight, according to a notice posted on DJI’s Chinese website. The notice did not list the affected models or specify how much […]

items.title: BYD’s Denza launches five-seat N8 SUV with up to 1,003 km of electric range
items.raw_content: BYD’s premium brand Denza has launched the N8 in China, with prices ranging from RMB 269,900 to RMB 329,900. The five-seat SUV comes in four battery-electric and two plug-in hybrid versions. Its longest-range electric variant pairs rear-wheel drive with a 130.15 kWh Blade Battery and is rated for 1,003 km under China’s CLTC test cycle. […]

items.title: In Nvidia’s Shadow, a Chinese Chipmaker Takes a Different Route
items.raw_content: Editor’s note: Denglin Technology, a Chinese maker of general-purpose GPUs for AI computing, went public in Hong Kong on November 10, raising HK$1.41 billion. items.title: ByteDance’s AI chip chief has submitted his resignation, report says
items.raw_content: Shi Yunfeng, who leads ByteDance’s AI chip and data processing unit teams, has submitted his resignation and is handing over his responsibilities, LatePost reported. Shi joined ByteDance in 2018 and reports to Yang Zhenyuan, who heads the company’s cloud business, Volcano Engine. ByteDance began building its AI chip team in 2019 and pursued a custom […]

items.title: Xiaohongshu tests standalone app for users to build and share AI agents
items.raw_content: Xiaohongshu, the Chinese social platform also known as RedNote, is testing a standalone app called Dada that lets users turn their expertise into AI agents others can use. Ebrun found dozens of agents in the app, covering tasks such as design, job hunting and studying. Users can interact with them through text and images. Dada […]

items.title: MetaX and UBTech-backed robotics chip startup Xilect raises RMB 500 million
items.raw_content: Xilect, a robotics chip startup jointly founded by Chinese GPU maker MetaX and humanoid robot maker UBTech Robotics, has raised RMB 500 million in an angel round. The company will use the funding to develop its first chip and supporting software, expand its engineering team and test the platform with robot manufacturers. Xilect is designing […]

items.title: When robots dive underwater, HeymanDex sees new possibilities for dexterous hands
items.raw_content: Dexterous hands are becoming a new focus of competition in the humanoid robotics industry. Companies are working to improve robots’ hand capabilities in terms of degrees of freedom, gripping force and movement precision.
